name: How long does a pool demolition take in the LA area?

mainEntity.name: How many days does pool demolition usually take in Los Angeles, and what steps can make it take longer?
mainEntity.text: How many days does pool demolition usually take in Los Angeles, and what steps can make it take longer?

acceptedAnswer.text: The actual demolition work is often completed in a few days, but the full project timeline can be longer once permits, utility shutoffs, inspections, hauling, and grading are included. Small, accessible pools may move quickly, while larger concrete pools, tight access sites, hillside properties, and projects that require city inspections can take much longer. Delays often come from waiting on permit approval, utility disconnection, weather, or haul-off logistics. Homeowners should ask for a schedule that separates pre-construction, demolition, backfill, and final grading. It also helps to confirm whether the contractor can coordinate inspections and whether the crew needs to return for compaction or final cleanup. A realistic timeline prevents surprises and helps align the project with landscaping or remodeling plans.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most pool demolition projects in Los Angeles take a few days to about two weeks, depending on pool size, access, permit timing, utility disconnects, hauling, and backfill. Tight access, concrete pools, and inspection delays can extend the schedule.
